documentation.content: Cloud Run has refused more than 1 request/min with a 401 for 15 minutes (LLD 5 section 9). The metric counts every 401 at the edge, labelled by service, so this is an aggregate edge-denial rate: expired or missing ID tokens, a misconfigured App Check token, or a client whose reCAPTCHA key was rotated. Split it by `callable` on the dashboard before assuming App Check.
